name: Coarse-to-fine Sparse Volume Training
definition: Training pipeline using rendering supervision with ground truth images, without extra geometry supervision. Includes pre-training local reconstruction and end-to-end training of full pipeline.
summary: Coarse-to-fine Sparse Volume Training is a fine-tuning method for sparse neural radiance fields that achieves high-fidelity novel view synthesis with reduced training time by iteratively pruning and subdividing voxels during optimization.
